sources.snippet: Prithvi-EO-2.-600M-TL outperforms the previous Prithvi-EO model by 8% across a range of tasks. It also outperforms six other geospatial foundation models when benchmarked on remote sensing tasks from different domains and resolutions (i.e. from 0.1m to 15m).

sources.snippet: Training data Prithvi-EO-2.-600M was pretrained on NASA's HLS V2 product (30m granularity) using 4.2M samples with six bands in the following order: Blue, Green, Red, Narrow NIR, SWIR1, SWIR 2. Sample results Here are a few results from the model.

sources.title: Introduction to the model—ArcGIS AI models | Documentation
sources.snippet: The model is designed to support similarity search, pattern analysis, and downstream deep learning workflows. Unlike task-specific models that directly produce classifications or detections, Prithvi-EO-2.-600M focuses on learning rich feature representations that can be reused across a variety of geospatial applications.
